subject: Re: Temporary no-PO path request for NovaCorp pilot
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@novacorp.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@novacorp.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 07:12:00 +0200
Subject: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to kick off a small pilot (3 internal teams, low monthly spend) but our internal PO process is taking 6+ weeks and we need to get infra time scheduled. Is there an established temporary "no-PO" intake or invoice-only path Redwood can use for short pilots?

What we can provide quickly: statement of work (attached), vendor questionnaire answers, and a PO once procurement completes the formal flow — but that will be after the pilot start. For now we need an invoice route or short-term exception approval.

Can you let me know:
- The minimum evidence Redwood needs to allow invoice-only billing for a 30–90 day pilot.
- Any dollar thresholds or temporal limits you require for an exception.
- Whether we need a separate commercial sign-off or if procurement can sign an acknowledgment email.

Attaching: nova_onboarding_sow.pdf (pilot scope & estimated spend).

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement, NovaCorp
elena@novacorp.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novacorp.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Hi Elena — glad to hear you're ready to start. We can support a time-limited invoice-only path for small pilots but we need a short checklist and an internal approval. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

1) Evidence we need (we'll provide a checklist PDF):
   - Signed SOW or email confirmation of scope (you attached the SOW — good).
   - Procurement contact and billing address (for invoicing).
   - Security evidence: SOC 2 report (or recent attestation) + summary of data residency, and a signed DPA if processing personal data.
   - W-9 is not applicable for EU entities; VAT registration or equivalent tax certificate is fine.

2) Dollar/temporal limits we typically accept for a provisional exception:
   - Up to $50k equivalent total spend for a 90-day pilot, or up to $15k for a 30-day quick trial.
   - Net30 invoice terms once the invoice is issued.

3) Approvals and documentation:
   - We require a short procurement approval (procurement send an approval email to finance@redwood.com) and an internal risk attestation from security.

Next steps we suggest:
- Priya (cc'd) — can you confirm finance/PO exception routing and whether we need Legal sign-off on the DPA before issuing the first invoice?
- Elena — please send vendor billing details and attach your VAT or tax cert. If you can provide SOC 2 or a link, that will speed approval.

I am happy to approve a provisional 30-day invoice-only route while Legal reviews the DPA — once Legal signs off we can extend to 90 days per the thresholds above. Attaching an evidence checklist (I will send the formal checklist in final).

Best,
Kimberly Park
AM, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Kimberly — tagging in Finance/Onboarding rules. Quick notes from finance perspective:

- We can approve a provisional invoice-only path for pilots under $15k without a formal PO, with a 30-day window. For anything between $15k–$50k we need a signed procurement email plus an internal risk acceptance.
- Legal must sign the DPA before we move past 30 days. If NovaCorp provides the SOC 2 summary and VAT cert we can queue the invoice.
- Please confirm the billing entity; we will issue invoices to the billing contact and route payment per net30.

I recommend we start with a 30-day invoice-only pilot (low friction) and if all good, convert to a 90-day pilot with a PO or signed acknowledgment letter.

Priya Natarajan
Onboarding & Finance Operations — Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@novacorp.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding — request for temporary no-PO path

Hi Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per internal review we can provide a provisional 30-day invoice-only path to get you started. Summary of what we need from NovaCorp to kick off tomorrow: 

- Billing contact and billing address (for invoice creation).
- VAT certificate or equivalent tax registration (attachment or PDF).
- SOC 2 summary or a pointer to your attestation; if unavailable, a recent security questionnaire response will suffice for the pilot.
- Signed SOW or email approval confirming scope (we have your SOW attached from earlier).

Attachments: no-po-evidence-checklist.pdf (checklist of required items and the provisional approval form).

Operational notes:
- We'll invoice after the first month of usage; terms Net30.
- This exception is valid for 30 days from invoice issuance; to extend to 90 days we need Legal to sign the DPA and Procurement to send a confirmation email to finance@redwood.com.

If you can send the billing details and VAT cert today I will route the provisional approval to Finance and copy you when the invoice is generated.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
